_about: Benzene (1) + Isobutanol (2): isothermal total pressures at 313.15 K. Rows: temperature in K, liquid mole fraction of benzene, pressure in kPa, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record. Rows with x_1 = 0 and 1 are the pure-component pressures measured with the same set.

source.citation: R. M. Villamanan, C. R. Chamorro, M. C. Martin, J. J. Segovia, Phase equilibria properties of binary and ternary systems containing di-isopropyl ether + isobutanol + benzene at 313.15K, Fluid Phase Equilib. 239 (2006) 178-182
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 5, 6. The table number in the article was not checked.
